## This week ...

Working with data that's nominally larger than the amount of RAM you have. Also talking programatically to computers that store way more data than you could fit on your computer.

## Required Reading

- @wickham23:_r_data_scien.

[Read the text online.](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/). Take a look at [Chapter 21](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/databases) on databases. It uses a different database back-end from the one we'll use in class, but the ideas are the same.

## Examples

[This week's examples](/example/09-example-databases.qmd) have some
demonstrations of how to use the Census API via `tidycensus`. The `tidycensus`
documentation and book has many more examples.

## Assignment

[This week's assignment](/assignment/09-assignment-databases.qmd). The assignment has some more reading, and is a gentle introduction to relational data: working with several related tables from the `nycflights23` package, identifying the keys that connect them, and joining them together.
